data/windrivers/gm.dls is the General MIDI sound set of Mime's wavetable synth, served from the ROM as
C:\Windows\System32\drivers\gm.dls. It is made from GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 by S. Christian Collins
(https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS, GeneralUser-GS.sf2), under the license in GeneralUser-GS-License.txt,
which lets the bank be used in software projects and modified. The conversion is tools/sf2dls.c of the research
repository: it keeps the 128 melodic programs and the standard drum kit, brings the samples to at most 22050 Hz and
stores them as 4 bit ADPCM, so the samples are not the originals.

The license says the author cannot be sure where every sample of the bank came from, and that none of them came from a
commercially published SoundFont or sample CD.
